g.text: afe_dq_ctrl_pwm: MATLAB Function of the library block grid_forming_dqctrl (dev 57cdc00), as used by telema_vfc_s; GFM1 master, GFM2 slave;
negative-sequence compensator on (nsc_enable = 1). Signal names as in the code, [n] = column of ctrl_log (grid_forming_log_index).
= 777.8 A; voltages and currents of the control in pu.
control step: on the rising edge of TRGO, every
angle of all the frame transforms;
i.e. sync_out of GFM1; it runs acquisitions,
FHT (log only), current loop and PWM; its
phase generator and voltage PIs stay at rest.
in the negative frame: the PIs see DC
values; no average or notch filter.
: resonant terms in the current loop,
in the positive frame; the PI alone
would track it with an error. The PI
one step delay: the step uses the
control step on its rising edge:
